name: wheel-picker
title: Wheel picker
description: Scrolling columns that snap to a value, for times, durations and numbers on a phone: swipe, tap or use the arrow keys.
docs: columns is a list of { id, options, loop, label }, and wheelRange(from, to, { step, pad }) from wheel-picker/wheel writes numbers as options. value and onValueChange speak an array with the chosen value of every column, reported when a swipe comes to rest. It draws no surface of its own: put it on a card, or in a Drawer.
